calls.statement:
SELECT d.fiscal_period, (f.member_key IS NULL AND o.member_key IS NOT NULL) AS line_null_order_member,
 count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) orders, sum(f.net_amount) net,
 count_if(m.member_key IS NULL AND o.member_key IS NOT NULL) lines_order_member_not_in_dim,
 count_if(m.join_date > f.sale_date) lines_before_join,
 count_if(CAST(f.sale_ts_utc AS DATE) <> f.sale_date) utc_date_diff,
 count_if(CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE) <> f.sale_date) order_date_diff
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = o.member_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-03-22' AND f.channel_id IN (2,3)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

calls.statement:
SELECT d.fiscal_period, count(*) ret_lines, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, count_if(r.sales_line_id NOT IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line)) orphan
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-03-22' AND f.channel_id IN (2,3)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
  round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN o.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount END) / sum(f.net_amount), 2) AS member_share_of_web_sales_pct,
  round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount END) / sum(f.net_amount), 2) AS uncorrected_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
  AND f.channel_id IN (2, 3)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
